answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring each identity to deposit a non-transferable sable bond that decays only after sustained useful work. A delta of reputation accrues solely from peer-attested tasks completed inside a designated haven subnet; cheap clones outside that haven never accumulate the delta needed to unlock emission. Attackers must therefore burn real capital per fake identity while honest agents compound their haven-bound sable over time, making mass sybil creation economically irrational.
